pageTitle: Sedno — fewer difficult words, more understanding
metaDescription: Sedno simplifies and corrects text in 13 language variants. Type, take a photo or speak aloud.
lead: An official letter, a long message, complicated instructions. Sedno helps you understand them in simpler language. It can also correct your writing and read it aloud.
sampleOriginal: To arrange a change to your appointment, please contact us by telephone.
sampleSimple: Want to change your appointment? Call us.
sampleWrong: i cant make it to the meeting tomorow
sampleCorrect: I can’t make it to the meeting tomorrow.
sampleNote: An illustrative example of text simplification.
purposeEyebrow: Easier to understand. Easier to act.
purposeText: We are creating Sedno mainly for people who are hard of hearing and people who find complex text difficult to understand. Simpler words can help any of us.
stepDescriptions: Type, paste, take a photo or speak aloud.
Choose what you need. The result appears in the same field. You can keep editing it.
instructionsIntro: Each example shows one task. A circle shows what to press. An arrow shows what happens next.
diagramNote: These are simplified drawings of the screens. The texts are examples. The app may look slightly different.
exampleIntros: Have a difficult message? Type or paste it into Sedno.
Have a letter on paper? Take a photo in Sedno.
Want to speak instead of typing? Choose {simplify} mode.
Want to fix mistakes in your message? Choose {correct} mode before typing.
In {correct} mode, your phone can read the text in the field aloud.
frameDescriptions: The result appears in the same field. You can edit it.
This opens the camera in the app.
Hold your phone so the whole page and text are clear.
Move the frame corners around the text you want to simplify.
Sedno reads the text from the photo and simplifies it.
If your phone asks for microphone access, allow it.
Speak in your selected language. Pause briefly when you finish.
After 1.5 seconds of silence, Sedno simplifies the recognized text automatically.
Change mode with the arrows above the large button.
Sedno fixes mistakes. Check that the text says what you mean.
Correct the text first. Then press the speaker on the left.
Your phone reads aloud. The stop button stops reading.
photoNote: The photo stays on your phone. Only the recognized text is sent to AI. If simplification fails, the recognized text stays in the field so you can edit it.
speechNote: Speech is recognized on your phone. You need Android 13 or later, support for this feature and a downloaded model for your selected language. Recording lasts up to one minute. Stop cancels recording.
playbackNote: Reading aloud works on your phone. Download an offline voice for your selected language in your phone settings.
soundListen: Listen to text from your phone.
copyHelp: To copy text, press and hold it, select it and choose “Copy” from your phone’s menu.
clearHelp: Changing mode, the eraser, microphone and camera clear the current text. Save any text you need before using them.
submissionHelp: Before you first send text, Sedno explains that it will be sent to AI. Simplifying and correcting need an internet connection. Text can have up to 4000 characters.
aiNote: AI can make mistakes. Check important information against the original.
privacyDescriptions: Text is read from photos on your device. The photo itself is not sent.
Your phone recognizes speech and reads text locally. Sedno does not send audio to its server or OpenAI. Only recognized text is sent for simplification.
Text for simplification or correction goes through the server to OpenAI. The Sedno server does not save its content.
Encrypted history is saved only on your device for 7 days. You can delete it sooner. Signing out deletes history from your phone.
closingText: A download link will appear here after release.
languagesText: Sedno supports 13 language variants. In the app, open the menu and choose Language. Your choice also applies to text, dictation and reading aloud. Sedno simplifies and corrects; it does not translate between languages.
accountGuideIntro: Open Sedno on your phone. Follow these steps in order.
accountGuideNote: The red circle shows where to tap. These screens come from the app. The email is an example.
accountGuideDescriptions: Tap the person icon at the top right.
Tap the button in the red circle.
Tap “{createAccountLink}”. If you cannot see it, swipe up.
Enter your email address. Choose a password with at least 6 characters. Enter the same password again below. Tap “{createAccount}”.
Find the email from Sedno. Check Spam too. Open the email and tap the link to confirm your email address.
Open Sedno again. If you still see this screen, tap “{checkVerification}”.
You can see your email address. Your account is ready.
accountGuideMailBody: Confirm your email address in Sedno.
accountGuideHelp: No email? Go back to Sedno. Wait for “{resendEmail}” to appear and tap it. Then check your email again.
